title: AAK celebrates the "Wild Wisdom" behind sustainable wild-harvested ingredients
summary: AAK is proud to take part in FairWild Week 2026, spotlighting the people, plants, and landscapes behind sustainably and ethically wild-harvested ingredients found in everyday food, herbal, and cosmetic products

extraction.key_fact: 에이에이케이가 지속가능하고 윤리적으로 야생 수확된 원료를 조명하는 페어와일드 위크에 참여한다.
